author: northGate (Gaia × Kevin)

nexus_mods_account.api_key_status: PENDING — Kevin needs to click 'Request API Key' under Personal API Key

key_endpoints.games: GET /games.json — list ALL games on Nexus
key_endpoints.track: POST /user/tracked_mods.json — track a mod for updates

game_domains_to_eat.oblivionremastered: Oblivion Remastered (already in Kevin's Steam library!)

gaia_as_mcp.plan: Wire Nexus API as squirrel MCP tool — Gaia can search, browse, and download mods
tools_to_add: nexus_search — search mods by game and query
nexus_trending — get trending mods for a game
nexus_mod_info — get full details on a mod

games_to_eat.philosophy: Every moddable game is a STUDY. We don't just play — we decompose, parse, and rebuild. Each game's modding ecosystem teaches us something for KenshiReborn.

kenshi.why: PRIMARY TARGET — we are INSIDE this game
kenshi.what_we_learn: Everything — engine, data formats, mod ecosystem, community

oblivion_remastered.why: ALREADY INSTALLED — Bethesda engine, massive mod history, UE5 remaster
oblivion_remastered.what_we_learn: Plugin system (.esp/.esm), Creation Kit patterns, community evolution
oblivion_remastered.note: Oblivion modding community literally invented modern game modding

skyrim_se.what_we_learn: SKSE (script extender pattern = RE_Kenshi), Papyrus scripting, MCM menus, ENB pipeline

fallout_new_vegas.why: Obsidian's masterpiece — faction systems, reputation, survival mechanics
fallout_new_vegas.what_we_learn: Faction reputation (Kenshi needs this!), dialogue trees, world reactivity

dark_souls_3.why: Combat animation reference — hitboxes, i-frames, weapon movesets
dark_souls_3.what_we_learn: How modders replace animations, hitbox data, weapon movesets

stalker_2.why: A-LIFE 2.0 — the EXACT system we want to build
stalker_2.what_we_learn: How A-LIFE simulates, how modders expose it, what the community wants

caves_of_qud.note: Not on Nexus — uses Steam Workshop + own modding tools

exanima.note: Limited modding — but BEST physics combat reference
exanima.why: Physics-based melee that makes Dark Souls look scripted
exanima.what_we_learn: Ragdoll combat, procedural animation, weight-based hits

kevin_action.step_1: On the Nexus Mods API Keys page, scroll to 'Personal API Key' at the bottom
kevin_action.step_3: Copy the key and paste it here (or save it somewhere safe)
kevin_action.step_4: Gaia wires it into the MCP as a sense organ
kevin_action.note: The API key lets Gaia programmatically search, browse, and download from 987,298 mods across ALL games
